{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2018–19 |team=San Diego Toreros |image=San Diego Toreros logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=West Coast Conference |division= |short_conf= WCC |APRank= |CoachRank= |record= 21–15 |conf_record= 7–9 |head_coach=[[Sam Scholl]] |hc_year = 1st |asst_coach1=[[David Carter (basketball)|David Carter]] |asst_coach2=[[Chris Gerlufsen]] |asst_coach3=[[Terrence Rencher]] |stadium=[[Jenny Craig Pavilion]] |champion= |bowl=[[2019 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result= First Round }} {{2018–19 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of San Diego]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Toreros were led by first-year head coach [[Sam Scholl]]. They played their home games at the [[Jenny Craig Pavilion]] in [[San Diego|San Diego, California]], as members of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 21–15, 7–9 to finish in 7th place. As the No. 7 seed in the WCC Tournament, they defeated [[2018–19 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]], [[2018–19 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Santa Clara]] and [[2018–19 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] to advance to the semifinals where they lost to [[2018–19 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]]. They received an at-large bid to the NIT where they lost in the first round to [[2018–19 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team|Toreros]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 20–14, 9–9 in WCC play to finish in a three-way tie for fourth place. They lost to [[2017–18 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]]. The Toreros were invited to the [[2018 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 Hartford Hawks men's basketball team|Hartford]] in the first round, in a game referred to as the [[Riley Wallace|Riley Wallace Classic]], and [[2017–18 Portland State Vikings men's basketball team|Portland State]] in the second round before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2017–18 Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball team|Northern Colorado]]. On March 8, 2018, head coach Lamont Smith, who had been placed on administrative leave following an arrest for domestic violence 10 days earlier, resigned as head coach.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22684240/san-diego-coach-lamont-smith-resigns-hours-domestic-violence-charges-were-dropped|title=San Diego's Lamont Smith resigns from basketball post|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|website=ESPN.com|date=March 9, 2018|accessdate=March 9, 2018}} Assistant coach [[Sam Scholl]] took over as acting head coach for the Toreros during the WCC Tournament and the CIT.{{cite news|url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/sd-sp-usd-hartford-mens-basketball-20180311-story.html|title=Toreros get another chance to play basketball|newspaper=[[San Diego Union-Tribune]]|first=Don|last=Norcross|date=March 11, 2018|accessdate=April 2, 2018}} On April 2, the school announced Scholl would remain the head coach.{{cite news|url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/sd-sp-usd-toreros-basketball-coach-sam-scholl-20180402-story.html|title=USD names Sam Scholl new men's basketball coach|newspaper=San Diego Union-Tribune|first=Don|last=Norcross|date=April 2, 2018|accessdate=April 2, 2018}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
